requirements.name: Attributable specimen lifecycle
requirements.material_effect: Scientists see one current state while the full decision history remains reconstructable.

requirements.name: Versioned custody transfer
requirements.material_effect: Laboratory operations can locate a specimen and resolve concurrent movement safely.

requirements.name: Raw-artifact-preserving instrument ingress
requirements.material_effect: Scientific reviewers can connect a reported observation to the exact received bytes.

requirements.name: Configured vendor conformance
requirements.material_effect: Evaluators can distinguish platform compatibility from adapter plausibility.

requirements.name: Meaning-preserving migration and recovery
requirements.material_effect: The organization can move and recover records while preserving identity, meaning, lineage, signatures, and artifacts.

requirements.name: Tenant security and observable operation
requirements.material_effect: Owners can operate the service with attributable access, protected telemetry, and measurable recovery.

requirements.name: Workload-bound configuration and secret lifecycle
requirements.material_effect: Operators can rotate vendor credentials and change non-secret configuration through governed runtime stores while repositories, build artifacts, state, logs, fixtures, and telemetry preserve references or redacted metadata.

requirements.name: Accountable multidomain acceptance
requirements.material_effect: Scientific, Quality, and Regulatory decisions remain distinct, bounded, and reviewable.

requirements.name: Bounded automation caller
requirements.material_effect: A human, service, workflow, or AI caller selects a released operation while the service boundary continues to determine identity, authority, scope, effect, evidence, and recovery.

requirements.name: Canonical scientific and operational data primitives
requirements.material_effect: Scientists, evaluators, and implementers share precise temporal, identity, digest, quantity, unit, vocabulary, JSON, and state semantics across code, storage, migration, and evidence.

requirements.name: Enforced enterprise database boundaries
requirements.material_effect: Tenant isolation, audit reconstruction, transactional work, and representative performance arise from enforced database contracts that remain testable under concurrency and recovery.

requirements.name: Versioned database migration reconciliation and release
requirements.material_effect: The organization can explain, rehearse, compare, recover, and approve each database change while preserving scientific meaning and a reversible release posture.
